name: recompile
description: Refreshes scripts, requests Unity script compilation, and returns only after Unity is idle again. Stops Play Mode first: a compile in Play reloads the domain mid-run, which games rarely survive. The result includes a compile summary (errorCount/warningCount plus the error/warning messages) produced by this recompile, so no separate console-get-logs call is needed to check whether it succeeded. Compiler diagnostics only; other console output meanwhile is a count.

stopPlayMode.description: Exit Play Mode before compiling (default true). Unity cannot compile scripts on demand while playing, so with false the compile is deferred or dropped and no diagnostics are guaranteed.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for compilation/imports to finish.
